name: Skydio
description: Streams live Skydio Cloud drone telemetry into TAK as Cursor-on-Target and receives Skydio webhook events for flight state, device alerts, and live stream status.

permissions.description: Skydio posts live drone positions to the map
Posts Skydio device and flight state alerts to the map

schedule.description: Polls Skydio Cloud for updated drone telemetry on a schedule.

webhook.description: Receives Skydio webhook events for flight state, device alerts, and live stream status.
